mapper.select: SELECT t1.id as material_detail_id,t1.rfid_head,t1.material_id,t1.material_name,t1.material_code,t1.location_id,t2.name as location_name,t1.rfid_count as stock_count ,(SELECT count(0) from t_stock_change_log where material_detail_id=t1.id) as tzcs from t_material_detail t1 LEFT JOIN t_location t2 on t2.id=t1.location_id WHERE t1.del_flag=0 and t1.material_code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%')
